<script type="text/javascript">
			function testimonials(id, opt) {
				$('#biz_media_logos').find('a').removeClass('onlogo');
				$(opt).addClass('onlogo');
				$('#biz_media_quote .mediaclass').hide();
				$('#biz_media_quote div:eq('+(id)+')').show();
			}
			
			var timer;
			var len=0;
			var current = 0;
			var buttons;
			var media;
			var slider = function(c) {
				if(current > len) {
					current = 0;
				}
				var e = $(buttons).get(current);
				var box = $(media).get(current);
				$(media).hide();
				$(box).show();
				$(buttons).removeClass('onlogo');
				$(e).addClass('onlogo');
				current++;
			};
			
			$(document).ready(function(){
				buttons = $('.logo-btn');
				media = $('.mediaclass');
				len = $(buttons).length-1;
				current = 1;
				timer = setInterval(slider, 6000);
				$('#biz_media').mouseenter(function(){
					clearTimeout(timer);
				}).mouseleave(function(){
					clearTimeout(timer);
					timer = setInterval(slider, 6000);
				});
				$(buttons).hover(function(){
					clearTimeout(timer);
					current = $(this).index();
					slider();
				}, function(){
				});
			});

		</script>
